verdict: One base for all three (100 = Jan 2021, first reliable month). Oct 1, 2026 marks: BS1E 184.11, BSSL 129.40, BS99 110.43; BS99 Oct 8, 2026 mark 112.90 (the Oct 6 BS99 row is a holo-rule divisor row, not quoted). Checklist: Base Set 102; Machamp 8/102 is 1st Edition only (2-Player starter), so BS1E 102 / BSSL 101 / BS99 101; the BSSL Oct 1 mark priced 102 and Machamp left Oct 4 with the level unchanged (divisorLog). Jan 2021 -> Aug 2026 (recon): +70.7% / +30.2% / +13.7%. Aug 2025 -> Aug 2026: +38.8% / +61.1% / +30.3%. Worst drawdown: -34.1% / -43.8% / -42.0%. Charizard ungraded sold medians (read Oct 9): 1st Ed $10,253.00 (4, Jul 18–Aug 31, 90d), Shadowless $1,091.50 (28, Jul 18–Oct 7, 90d; 2 in 30d), Unlimited $350.00 (29, Sep 29–Oct 9, 30d). PSA 9: 1st Ed no sale in 90d (1 dated sale, Jun 30, 2026, $69,900.00), Shadowless $11,750.00 (5, Jul 18–Sep 22, 90d), Unlimited $3,475.00 (5, Sep 10–29, 30d). PSA 10: 1st Ed no sale in 90d (1 dated sale, Jun 23, 2026, $343,098.00), Shadowless no sale in 90d, Unlimited $10,300.00 (3, Aug 14–Sep 9, 90d; $8,000–$31,000). Blastoise ungraded $1,537.50 (6, Jul 21–Oct 7, 90d) / $192.49 (10, Sep 9–Oct 8, 30d) / $95.00 (27, Oct 1–8, 30d); Venusaur $1,025.00 (10, Jul 11–Sep 17, 90d) / $192.50 (10, Sep 12–Oct 7, 30d) / $80.00 (23, Sep 27–Oct 7, 30d).
